title: .mergedesk.json
description: Per-repository Merge Desk configuration. Every key is optional; missing keys use the built-in defaults. Keep in sync with Sources/MergeDeskCore/Config/RepoConfig.swift.

^\\$.description: Keys starting with $ are notes or schema references and are ignored.

glob.description: * = any characters within one path segment, ? = one character, ** (whole segment) = any number of segments. Case-sensitive; no implicit match-anywhere.

argv.description: Program and arguments, run without a shell from the repository root.

integrationBranches.description: Branches every other branch is compared and predicted against, in display order.

primaryRemote.description: Remote whose branches are the team's shared state; branches are compared on its tips.

protectedBranches.description: Branch-name globs that only receive changes through a pull request.

staleDays.description: Days without a commit after which a branch counts as stale.

activeBranchPrefixes.description: Prefixes of active-work branches for the branch × branch matrix; empty = every non-integration branch.

fileClasses.description: Tier-1 rules; the first matching glob wins. Files matching no rule go to the history engine.

regenerateCommand.description: Run once after 'regenerate' files are taken. Required when any file class uses 'regenerate'.

verifyCommands.description: Run by the verification gate before a merge is marked ready.
